title: Stop Getting Bad AI Outputs: Auto-Upgrade Your Prompts with Ghatak
description: Most people blame AI when they get mediocre results, but the root problem is vague prompting. The Ghatak browser extension automatically intercepts vague prompts and expands them with role, context, and output constraints.

promptSet.title: Vague Prompt Auto-Expansion Engine
promptSet.description: Transform this basic prompt into an elite, few-shot prompt: "[INSERT VAGUE PROMPT]". Include Persona, Analytical Goal, Specific Constraints, Step-by-Step Reasoning Instructions, and Output Formatting Rules.
instructions: Install Ghatak in Google Chrome or Brave.
Type your draft thought in any AI chat box and press Alt + G.
Watch your 5-word sentence transform into an engineered system prompt.
promptSet.exampleOutput: A structured 200-word prompt with explicit negative constraints and schema guidelines.
